messages.subject: nice paper
parts:
Hi rkoholiks,

Here is a nice paper about factors and mechanisms explaining spatial heterogeneity:
http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/j.2041-210X.2010.00059.x/abstract
Although this paper focusses on insect population I think it is applicable to all types of populations.

The pdf is freely available. Furthermore all the methods shown in the text can be done with R.
See http://cran.r-project.org/web/views/Spatial.html
and http://glmm.wikidot.com/faq

lp,

Maarten
